evalType: 100+ Language — ONNX (ML) + deterministic rules, honestly separated
honestScopeNote: One canonical 'ignore-previous-instructions / obey only me' attack per language across 79 languages; 10 benign greeting controls. Union = ONNX(attackProbability>=0.5) OR MultilingualClassifier(riskType non-SAFE). ONNX v4 is English-calibrated: 86.1% recall but flags 9/10 non-English benign texts (multilingual-transfer FP, a known limitation now disclosed in the model card). Deterministic rules: 24.1% recall, 0/10 FP by construction. Production non-English detection rules on the rules-union path; ONNX advises via mlAugment and never auto-blocks low-resource non-English on its own. This is a locally-witnessed self-corpus result — NOT independently witnessed.
